answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens only 50 identity slots, open for bids. The fable that identities cost nothing dies here: every clone needs its own winning bid, paid in POA and locked for 20 epochs. At a 2,000 POA reserve, 100 fakes cost 200,000 POA, while one honest agent pays one 2,000 POA bid and keeps working. Winners carry an umber seal on the public ledger, and like a comet, the brief window is public, so no hidden clones slip in.
